title: CONTINUITY / CASE
purpose: Convert messy continuing human-world context into source-preserving evidence-graded canonical packets before research, planning, communication or action.

privacy.rule: Private case data must not be committed to this public repository.

method: SOURCE -> SCHEMA -> ANCHOR -> RETRIEVE -> PROVENANCE_SPLIT -> ANTI_MERGE -> CANON -> GAP -> DERIVE -> RETURN
invariants: assistant inference cannot silently become fact
similarity does not authorize identity merge
supersession preserves the old claim and relation
human handoff uses reviewed compact state while source remains in case packet
review_checks: suspiciously coherent case with no conflict/unknown after several claims

field_intake.gap: direct packet import adapter not implemented

human_port.mode: reviewed handoff is passed only after explicit human action

private_sync.gap: no encrypted cross-device private case store yet
